verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a bulk account or data export, a takeout feature, or any offboarding path that lets a user export all of their data and leave. The 16-bit EXR export is a per-render output format for VFX and compositing workflows. That is an adjacent feature, not export of all user data, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
